overview_description.description:
Cognite is an industrial AI and enterprise software company that develops data and artificial intelligence solutions for asset-intensive industries, such as energy, manufacturing, power and utilities, and process industries. Founded in 2016, the company helps industrial organizations unify and contextualize operational technology (OT), engineering technology (ET), and information technology (IT) data to accelerate digital transformation, improve operational efficiency, and enable enterprise-scale AI adoption.

The company's flagship platform, Cognite Data Fusion, serves as an industrial data and AI foundation that integrates data from disparate systems into a real-time industrial knowledge graph. This enables engineers, operators, maintenance teams, and data scientists to access trusted, contextualized information for use cases such as predictive maintenance, asset performance management, production optimization, digital twins, and operational analytics. Cognite also offers Cognite Atlas AI, a low-code platform for building and deploying AI agents that automate industrial workflows and support data-driven decision-making.
